entity.name: David Pagnon
entity.description: I'm a research engineer from France., creator and maintainer of Pose2Sim and Sports2D, which are open-source, peer-reviewed markerless motion capture pipelines for biomechanics, sports science, and 3D animation.

projects.name: Pose2Sim
projects.description:
Open-source Python pipeline for markerless 3D motion capture and kinematics from multiple cameras: calibration, 2D pose estimation, synchronization, person association, triangulation, filtering and OpenSim inverse kinematics. Used for biomechanics, sports science, clinical research and 3D animation.

Evidence of impact: published in the Journal of Open Source Software and in peer-reviewed validation papers; used in academic research (see Google Scholar citations); active Discord community of about 200 members who help each other and share their work. All processing runs locally, which makes it compatible with GDPR constraints that cloud-based alternatives struggle with.

Users: researchers, clinicians, sports coaches and, increasingly, 3D animation artists.

projects.name: Sports2D
projects.description:
Open-source Python pipeline for markerless 2D motion capture and kinematics from a single camera or webcam: 2D pose estimation, clean-up, pixel to meter conversion, and OpenSim inverse kinematics. Used for biomechanics, sports science, and clinical research.

Evidence of impact: published in the Journal of Open Source Software and in peer-reviewed validation papers; used in academic research (see Google Scholar citations); active Discord community of about 200 members who help each other and share their work. All processing runs locally, which makes it compatible with GDPR constraints that cloud-based alternatives struggle with.

Users: researchers, clinicians, sports coaches.

projects.name: Pose2Sim_Blender
projects.description: Blender add-on to visualize Pose2Sim results (calibrated cameras, 3D motion, and other tools) and to use them in 3D animation workflows.
